header: What partners get and what they give
subheader: For resellers, integrators, affiliates and distributors.
lead: Rich text beside an image, with a full-width grid of benefits below.
bodytext:
Put the obligations in the rich text. It comes before the benefits on purpose, because a page that only lists benefits attracts the wrong applications.

On screens narrower than a tablet, the two halves stack and the benefits follow at full width.
note: The note says what happens after someone applies: how often you review applications and what a reply includes.

benefits.title: Zero to six benefits
benefits.text: Each has an icon, a title and one sentence. With no benefits, the band is a plain split layout.

benefits.title: Two to four columns
benefits.text: The grid adapts to the space it has, not to the screen width.

benefits.title: Media on either side
benefits.text: The reverse switch swaps the halves. Screen readers still read the text in the same order.

benefits.title: One button, one link
benefits.text: The link is for readers who want the terms before the form.
